data.body:
SCOPE UPDATED BY OPERATOR DIRECTION — two changes, both enlarging the epic.

1. [rebar:b586-2fda-8a15-4260] RATE LIMITER IS IN SCOPE. Re-parented under this epic and re-typed
   story. I had argued it was an absent feature rather than a defect; the operator's counter is
   stronger and I should have weighted it higher — an integration that falls over on a rate-limited
   instance is broken for that customer, and 'the admin has to enable it' is thin when Data Center
   exists for exactly the large self-hosted deployments most likely to enable throttling.

2. [rebar:5200-e04e-246e-4aae] NEW STORY J11 — prove the headline AC properly. The previous live run
   reported 'scanned=0 ... converged', which proves the reconciler runs cleanly against an EMPTY
   instance and proves nothing about data moving. J11 runs the verification against a COPY OF THIS
   PROJECT'S REAL TICKET STORE so the pass sees realistic volume, ticket shapes, link graphs and
   comment histories, plus a comprehensive suite of DC-side mutations each asserted to round-trip
   individually rather than behind an aggregate 'converged' line.

ISOLATION IS THE FIRST REQUIREMENT OF J11, not a caveat. rebar AUTO-PUSHES ticket events to
sync.remote, so a copy of this project's store that kept its configuration could push test mutations
back at the real project. Per operator direction the primary mechanism is A SEPARATE REPO WITH NO
REMOTE — CI git-inits a fresh repo and never adds origin, so there is physically nowhere to push,
independent of any flag. REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, an empty sync.remote, and the total absence of Cloud
credentials from the job environment are additional independent layers. Every one of them is ASSERTED
by a test that fails the job, because safety that is not tested is only an intention.

EPIC CLOSURE now requires, under the operator's 'ship defect-free' standard: J8 (ADR, drafted),
J11 (live proof), b586 (rate limiter), and the three shipped-code defects 21fc, 387d, 7c26 — plus
f391, which must be fixed for the oracle J11 depends on to be trustworthy at all.
